[list]

notes.title: 'My Little Puppy' will support 4 more languages!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289174/1bfa89320227961fda63fbe125e5e036b73fa409.png[/img]

We’re excited to announce that [b]4 additional languages[/b] have been added to 'My Little Puppy'!
[list]
[*] Portuguese-Brazil
[*] Polish
[*] Turkish
[*] Thai
[/list]

Additionally, the Steam store page game description are translated, and you can play the official demo with the newly added languages as well!

If you notice any translation errors or have feedback, please feel free to share it with us through the [u]Community Hub[/u].

We sincerely appreciate your continued interest in 'My Little Puppy,' scheduled for release in the second half of 2025. 

Don’t forget to add it to your wishlist! 🙏

notes.title: My Little Puppy was featured at Indie Live Expo!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289174/f916b9c413e294ffb28c7b0c67107884d1255fd4.png[/img]

My Little Puppy was featured in Indie Live Expo, a global showcase that draws the attention of indie game fans worldwide! 🐶✨

It was introduced in the "Indie Spotlight" corner during the live showcase, and also listed in the "Pick Up Titles" section on the official website.

You can find more details through the links below. 😊
- [url=https://youtu.be/iQM26fwUmY0?t=7535][Go to showcase featuring video][/url]
- [url=https://indie.live-expo.games/titles_en/1020200120TP012][Visit the official feature page][/url]

We kindly ask for your continued support and interest in My Little Puppy!

Thank you.
